remarks: Discover this brand-new, energy-efficient 2-bedroom apartment on the second floor, nestled on a private lot along Route 7 in beautiful Wilton, CT. Step into a modern custom kitchen featuring sleek granite countertops and a full suite of brand-new stainless steel appliances, including refrigerator, range, microwave, and dishwasher. Enjoy the ultimate convenience with an in-unit washer and dryer. The luxurious bathrooms boast elegant granite walls, paired with efficient heating and cooling systems for year-round comfort. Ample parking is available for residents and guests, and the prime location puts you close to shopping, dining, parks, trails, and easy access to Metro-North for commutes to NYC-all the best of Wilton right at your doorstep!
